nodes.description: Homozygous NM_000245.2:c.2521T>G (p.Phe841Val) segregated with severe early hearing loss in nine members of Pakistani family HLGM17 after linkage to 7q31.2. The variant lies in the extracellular IPT4 domain and was absent from the study controls and public databases examined in 2015. A linked regulatory variant remains an alternative explanation. Structural predictions suggest reduced protein stability, but receptor binding and signaling were not measured. An exon-trap assay was performed: 63 of 65 mutant-derived clones matched wild type, and the two aberrant products could reflect a small splice effect or artifacts. The separately reported p.Ile316Met variant is not treated as a confirmed pathogenic trigger.

nodes.description: Separate neural-crest and cochlear-epithelium conditional c-Met deletions impaired melanocyte incorporation into the stria vascularis and produced profound hearing loss.
